title: Lalita Ashtakam
intro: Lalita Ashtakam is a devotional hymn dedicated to Goddess Lalita Tripura Sundari. Read its lyrics, meaning, and benefits.
description:
Shri Lalita Pranam Stotram
Shri Lalitayai namah .

radhamukunda padasambhavagharmabindu
     nirmanchanopakaranikrita dehalaksham |
uttungasauhridavisheshavasat pragalbham
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 1||

rakasudhakiranamandalakantidandi
     vaktrashriyam chakitcharu chamurunetram |
radhaprasadhanavidhanakalaprasiddham
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 2||

lasyollasadbhujagashatrupatatrachitra
     pattamsukabharanakanchulikanchitangim |
gorocanaruchivigarhana gaurimanam
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 3||

dhurte vrajendratanaye tanu sushthuvamyam
     ma dakshina bhava kalankini laghavay |
radhe giram shrinu hitamiti shikshayantim
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 4||

radhamabhivrajpateh kritamaatmajena
     kutam managapi vilokya vilohitakshim |
vagbhangibhistamachirena vilajjayantim
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 5||

vatsalyavrindavasatim pashupalarajnyah
     sakhyanushikshanakalasu gurum sakhinam |
radhabalavaraja jivitanirvishesham
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 6||

yam kamapi vrajakule vrishabhanujayah
     prekshya svapakshapadavimanuruddhyamanam |
sadyastadishtaghatena kritarthayantim
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 7||

radhavrajendrasutasangamarangacharyam
     varyam vinishchitavatimakhilotsavebhyah |
tam gokulapriyasakhinikurambamukhyam
     devim gunaih sulalitam lalitam namami || 8||

nandanamuni lalitagunalalitani
     padyani yah pathati nirmaladrishtirashtau |
pritya vikarshati janam nijavrindamadhye
     tam kirtidapatikulojjvalakalpavalli || 9||

iti shri-rupa-gosvami-virachita-stavamalayam shri-lalitashtakam
              shri-lalita-pranam-stotram sampurnam .

faq.q1: Who composed Shri Lalita Pranam Stotram (Shri Lalitashtakam)?
faq.a1: It was composed by the great saint and acharya of the Gaudiya Vaishnava tradition, Shri Rupa Goswami.
faq.q2: From which text is this stotra taken?
faq.a2: This stotra is taken from the famous compilation 'Stavamala' by Shri Rupa Goswami.
faq.q3: What is the main purpose and theme of this stotra?
faq.a3: The main purpose is to offer prostrations and praise to Shri Lalita Devi, the chief sakhi and preceptor among the gopis in the eternal pastimes of Sri Radha-Krishna, highlighting her divine qualities, beauty, and unmatched devotion.
faq.q4: How many verses are there in this stotra?
faq.a4: There are a total of 9 verses in this stotra (8 verses of praise and the 9th verse describing its benefits / phalashruti).
faq.q5: What are the benefits of reciting Shri Lalita Pranam Stotram?
faq.a5: According to the phalashruti, a devotee who recites these verses with a pure mind attracts the love and grace of the divine associates in Vrindavan through the blessings of Shri Lalita Devi.
